limits: Five descriptive fresh-process samples per arm/profile/kind; no population confidence interval.
Per-child p95s summarized across children, never pooled.
Memory includes library/framework/application and in-memory service logs; contexts are dropped before GC.
Whole trace throughput and browser durations include validation/service work. Browser duration categories overlap and must not be summed.
Frame callback gaps are observations, not dropped-frame counts; absent samples retain null/missing statistics.
Model/network latency, actual agent reasoning, token cost, durable backend recovery and general production security are not measured.
